correctness.rationale: For each 2k+2-window, k+3 selected positions force two full opposite pairs and hence an induced P4. This gives the exact per-window cardinality upper bound. Separated selected runs of at most k+2 induce disjoint copies of cliques or cliques minus an edge, attaining the bound. Saturated final k+2-blocks force k preceding zeros and backwards rigidity. Shift/reverse witnesses prove all nonunique cases. Actual standalone verifier reproduced all 91 direct enumerations, 216 independent finite-state calculations, and 456 explicit witness cases; finite checks supplement the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural induced-cograph vertex deletion problem on powers of paths gains a sharp two-parameter exact formula, a periodic rigidity criterion for the unique optimum, and an explicit construction. A local induced-P4 certificate yields both structure and bound; the result strengthens the coarser two-cluster subcoloring guarantee for canonical unit-interval graphs.
